tokens.name: q-ink
tokens.usage: Warm near-black. All text, outlines and hard shadows on loud screens; fill of the primary button. 16:1 on q-paper, 18:1 on q-card, at least 8.5:1 on every player colour.

tokens.name: q-paper
tokens.usage: Page background of every loud screen (landing, setup, lobby, results). Text on it is q-ink.

tokens.name: q-card
tokens.usage: Card, input and secondary-button fill on loud screens; keycap fill inside a coloured row; counter digit boxes on the race.

tokens.name: q-desk
tokens.usage: The table the 1440×900 frames sit on in design files. Not used inside the product.

tokens.name: q-sunk
tokens.usage: Sunken panels on loud screens (light StatusPanel). q-ink text 14.6:1.

tokens.name: q-taken
tokens.usage: Fill of an avatar tile someone else has taken.

tokens.name: q-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy on q-paper, q-card and player colours (ModeCard description). 10.3:1 on q-paper, 5.5:1 on q-lilac.

tokens.name: q-ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted meta on q-paper, q-card and q-sunk (StatusPanel meta, hover on links). 6.4:1 on q-paper. Do not set text in it on pink or lilac (3.4:1).

tokens.name: q-ink-4
tokens.usage: Muted labels on q-paper and q-card (5.0 and 5.6:1). Below 4.5:1 on q-taken and every player colour: keep it off them.

tokens.name: q-ink-5
tokens.usage: Empty-seat label in the lobby, 16px on q-paper. Source value: 4.0:1 on q-paper, under the 4.5:1 floor for small text; flagged.

tokens.name: q-ink-6
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and a taken avatar's struck-through label. Source value: 3.0:1 on q-paper, 2.7:1 on q-taken; flagged. Never for content a racer must read.

tokens.name: q-line-dashed
tokens.usage: 3px dashed outline of empty seats and taken avatar tiles. A decorative edge, not a control border.

tokens.name: q-line-off
tokens.usage: Border of a disabled Pill.

tokens.name: q-avatar-off
tokens.usage: Keycap fill for a taken avatar.

tokens.name: q-lime
tokens.usage: Player colour 1 and the brand accent: wordmark bar, primary-button shadow, your caret, your counter shadow, selected cards. Text on it is q-ink (14.5:1).

tokens.name: q-pink
tokens.usage: Player colour 2; countdown beat 2. Text on it is q-ink (8.7:1).

tokens.name: q-sky
tokens.usage: Player colour 3; countdown beat 1; the Join button. Text on it is q-ink (9.9:1).

tokens.name: q-lilac
tokens.usage: Player colour 4; countdown beat 3. Text on it is q-ink (8.6:1).

tokens.name: q-orange
tokens.usage: Player colour 5. Text on it is q-ink (10.4:1).

tokens.name: q-mint
tokens.usage: Player colour 6. Text on it is q-ink (11.6:1).

tokens.name: q-sun
tokens.usage: Player colour 7. Text on it is q-ink (14.3:1).

tokens.name: q-magenta
tokens.usage: Player colour 8. Text on it is q-ink (7.8:1).

tokens.name: q-night
tokens.usage: The race surface and the start of the results reveal. Text on it: q-night-fg family.

tokens.name: q-night-card
tokens.usage: Cards on the night surface: Standings, StatusPanel, the progress rail, hidden result rows.

tokens.name: q-night-fg
tokens.usage: Typed passage text and primary text on q-night and q-night-card (14.4 / 13.4:1); outlines of night cards.

tokens.name: q-night-fg-2
tokens.usage: Body copy on night cards (Reconnecting… explanation). 6.8:1 on q-night-card.

tokens.name: q-night-fg-3
tokens.usage: Small labels on q-night and q-night-card: /96 total, room meta, rail start/finish, net wpm. 5.2 / 4.8:1. Also the grey that every avatar and caret turns while disconnected.

tokens.name: q-night-fg-4
tokens.usage: Untyped passage words (32px, so 3:1 applies: 3.4:1 on q-night). Too faint for small labels; the v1 frames used it at 10–13px, which fails, so race v2 moved those labels to q-night-fg-3.

tokens.name: q-night-fg-5
tokens.usage: Ghost elements only: the dashed ? box and empty name bar of a hidden result row, the faded night wordmark. 2.0:1, never text a racer needs.

tokens.name: q-night-line
tokens.usage: 2px rules inside night cards; the 10% tick marks on the progress rail.

tokens.name: q-night-hair
tokens.usage: 1.5px row dividers inside Standings; the name placeholder bar on hidden result rows.

tokens.name: q-night-edge
tokens.usage: Border of a hidden (not yet flipped) result row.

tokens.name: q-night-shadow
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow colour for every card on the night surface.

tokens.name: q-night-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper shadow under hidden result rows during the reveal.

tokens.name: q-error
tokens.usage: A wrong letter in the passage and the underline of a word that holds one. Muted on purpose, never bright red. 4.8:1 on q-night. Night only: 3.4:1 on q-paper.

styles.sample: group other real while system these
styles.usage: The race word field. Roboto Mono, the Monkeytype face; one-character gaps between words; 52px pitch.
